entry.title: Publication of Amendment to FSA Notice Designating Accounting Standards for Consolidated Financial Statements and Public Comment Results
entry.summary: 「連結財務諸表の用語、様式及び作成方法に関する規則に規定する金融庁長官が定める企業会計の基準を指定する件の一部を改正する件」の公布及びパブリックコメントの結果の公表 金融庁 · Sep 29, 2026 · RuleThe Financial Services Agency published an amendment to its notice designating accounting standards under the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation and released the results of a public comment period, which drew two comments. The amendment adds IFRS 20 Regulatory Assets and Regulatory Liabilities to the designated international accounting standards and removes IFRS 14 Regulatory Deferral Accounts. The amended notice takes effect on the date of publication.

entry.title: Notice of the cross-industry financial cybersecurity exercise (Delta Wall 2026) by the Financial Services Agency of Japan

entry.title: Japan's FSA announces another supported case under the FinTech Experiment Hub's Payment Innovation Project
entry.summary: 「FinTech実証実験ハブ・決済高度化プロジェクト（PIP）」支援決定案件の公表 金融庁 · Sep 29, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「本実証実験では、貿易取引における資金決済でのステーブルコインの活用について、実務上の対応を検証し、関連する法的論点の整理を行います。」 On September 29, 2026, the Financial Services Agency announced support for a demonstration experiment under the FinTech Experiment Hub and Payment Innovation Project (PIP). Six companies, including TradeWaltz, NTT DATA and several major Japanese banks, applied. The experiment will test practical use of stablecoins in settling trade payments and sort out related legal issues, and is expected to run from September 2026 for the time being. The FSA plans to publish the results after it ends.

entry.summary: 現下の情勢を踏まえたサイバーセキュリティ対策の強化と各種取引申込等における対応の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 · GuidanceOn October 9, 2026, Japan's Financial Services Agency issued a notice to financial institutions on cybersecurity and remote identity verification. It cites recent unauthorized access to customer-facing services that leaked customer data, including images of driver's licenses. The FSA asks institutions to review their cybersecurity measures and check identity documents and facial images for irregularities. It also asks them to move to IC chip reading for identity verification ahead of the April 1, 2027 effective date.

entry.title: Administrative Sanctions Against Prudential Life, Gibraltar Life, and Prudential Holding of Japan

Prudential Life and Gibraltar Life were ordered to suspend insurance solicitation and contract signing and to improve business operations. The holding company was ordered to improve its management of subsidiaries. The grounds cited include improper handling of money by sales staff, improper solicitation, and unauthorized removal of customer information.

entry.title: Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference summary (Oct 9, 2026): consumption tax and support payment bill

The briefing also covered reviews of tax incentives, subsidies and funds, a financial-sector cybersecurity alert, and the Kumamoto earthquake recovery support fund.
